test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
"Experts assert that maintaining mental wellness requires conscious effort and self-awareness."

Rewrite the sentence in passive voice.

options.text: Conscious effort and self-awareness are asserted by experts to be required for maintaining mental wellness.
Maintaining mental wellness is asserted by experts to require conscious effort and self-awareness.
Maintaining mental wellness has been asserted by experts as requiring conscious effort and self-awareness.
Conscious effort and self-awareness require to be asserted by experts for maintaining mental wellness.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 2: Maintaining mental wellness is asserted by experts to require conscious effort and self-awareness.***
